method: Read-only matched-map scan. Observable conditions are not labels of optimal actions; different policies visit different states. No model calls or game runs.

definitions.ready_attack_available: Non-Medivac, ready, known in-range visible target with a legal attack candidate.
definitions.melee_pressure_retreat_available: Own compatible native range >=4, enemy range <=1, known in own range, cooldown > step_mul, in enemy range or recently damaged, legal static endpoint improves minimum melee separation by >=0.5. Endpoint is not future motion prediction.
definitions.after_already_targeted: C only: previous native response 206 is present in current full observation; count live Medivac choice, same target remains legal, and other legal heal targets. Repeating is observable, not proof that the new command fails.
